python: Python is a programming language used to build AI applications.
llm: An LLM is a large language model that processes and generates text.
vector database: A vector database stores vectors and searches for similar ones.
pytorch: PyTorch is a framework for building and training neural networks.
rag: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) retrieves relevant information and provides it to a language model to help generate an answer.
embedding: An embedding represents data as a list of numbers that captures useful features, including aspects of meaning.
